dogecoin.text:
Coinbase Derivatives has launched the first margined CFTC-regulated futures contract for Dogecoin in the US. Traders can now hedge and express their views on DOGE's price without physical delivery - providing another way to access crypto.

Find out more: https://t.co/cCFa491z14 https://t.co/vApPV2J687

The best-performing asset was Dogecoin (DOGE) with a staggering 260%, likely driven by events like the proposed similarly-named Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE).

Bitcoin also saw a notable return of 123%. https://t.co/cE3zyOhYvx
